messages:
elaine: Heads-up I'm doing a small refresh of the Hello quickstart to cover a serverless deploy (Vercel/Netlify) and clarify auth. Want to avoid people pasting keys client-side.

matt: Love it. Can we show a tiny serverless proxy (edge function) and the recommended env var setup?

elaine: Yes — minimal edge function + example env config for Vercel. Calling out that client apps should call our backend endpoint, not the API directly.

sophia: I'll add a downloadable zip under /examples/hello-serverless and a one-liner to deploy to Vercel (vercel --prod). Also include a note about CORS and incognito testing.

kevin: Quick nit: include both curl and SDK v4 examples; some customers still ask for curl. 

elaine: Adding both. For curl we should show header + content-type. For SDK v4 show `client.text.generate({ input })` pattern.

docs-bot: Reminder: attach runnable sample under /examples, run linkcheck, add label 'quickstart-serverless'.

elaine: PR up in ~20m. Will add HEALTHCHECK equivalent note for serverless (ping endpoint).

matt: Also add a one-line troubleshooting section: 401 invalid_key, 429 rate_limit, and note about long sync calls timing out on cheap serverless plans.

sophia: I'll sanity-check the example on Netlify and Vercel. If any platform-specific tweak needed I'll post here.

ci-bot: CI will run linkcheck and sample-run once PR is opened.

elaine: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/859 — includes serverless proxy, Vercel steps, examples, and a short migration note for v3. Preview link will follow.

matt: Quick review done — left one small suggestion: clarify env var name REDWOOD_API_KEY vs REDWOOD_KEY in examples.

elaine: Fixed and pushed. Thanks.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR 859 (linkcheck ok, sample-run ok). Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/quickstart/hello-serverless

sophia: Smoke-tested on Vercel. Proxy works, env var injection ok. No CORS surprises when using server-side proxy.

elaine: Great. I'll merge and backport the short note into the onboarding lab. Ship target: today. :shipit:
